json.title: JSON API round-trip (serialize / parse)
json.description: Serialize a 200-record array, parse it back and sum the parsed fields. Spid3r uses json_write/json_parse, PHP json_encode/json_decode, Python json.dumps/json.loads. All produce byte-identical 9,163-character JSON.

map.title: String-keyed map lookups (routing / session)
map.description: Build a 64-entry string-keyed table, then do 100,000 lookups with a freshly constructed key each time. Mirrors route / config / session lookups.

text.title: Text template building (string churn / allocation)
text.description: Build a user-record template string per row (number formatting, concatenation, length measurement) with a rolling hash over string lengths. Exercises string allocation and GC pressure, like log/report generation.

matmul.title: Integer matrix multiply (numeric loops / indexing)
matmul.description: Classic i-k-j matmul with a transposed B (built untimed) so every language multiplies row-by-row. Integer-only arithmetic keeps checksums exact across languages. Exercises nested indexing and tight numeric loops.
